verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented system-to-system channel for software to transact with the registry, such as system accounts, transmitter or batch-provider programs, or a published enrollment path. The prepaid account application and the mass registered-agent change PDF are adjacent payment and bulk-paper mechanisms, not machine rails. The keyless Socrata data API is read-only open data served by a separate host platform, not a transactional channel.
